basis.scientific_rationale: The qualified target is donor-recurrent biology; cells within a donor are not independent biological replicates, so raw cell count must not set donor objective mass.

proposal_policy.note: For a donor-uniform target, this candidate proposal has approximately 40.6% importance-sampling ESS on frozen reader_fit versus approximately 9.7% under raw cell-uniform proposal. Proposal choice remains separate authority because repeat/exposure behavior also matters.

relational_scientific_target.triplet_budget_note: The finite triplet count controls Monte Carlo variance/compute only; each group contributes a mean, so large groups do not acquire more scientific weight merely because their combinatorial triplet space is larger.
